episodes.synopsis: Gawain's encounter with Quester from the U.S. team leaves him in shock. Lancelot joins some of his American counterparts for a training session.
episodes.title: Worthy New Opponents

episodes.synopsis: Still rattled from his previous match with Quester, Gawain keeps duffing his shots. While he deals with his mental block, Platalissa confides in him.
episodes.title: The Door to One's Soul

episodes.synopsis: A surprise change to the U.K. team's order of play disrupts Ms. Aria's strategy for the Japan team, but Gawain and Lancelot rise to the challenge.
episodes.title: Camelot Cup Competition!

episodes.synopsis: As the pairs take on increasingly tricky courses, Gawain struggles with his control and strength — until he begins to see the sparks of a new power.
episodes.title: An Awakened Power

episodes.synopsis: Quester begins to lose confidence after witnessing Gawain's incredible growth. After coasting in the first half, Sfida and Ice turn the heat up.
episodes.title: The Brits Go Into Overdrive

episodes.synopsis: Faced with the final two holes, the U.K. and U.S. teams go all out. Will Gawain and Lancelot be able to clinch victory for the Japan team?
episodes.title: The Way to Victory

episodes.synopsis: While Liebel and Todoin brood over their poor performance against Tristan, the other players gear up for the Camelot Cup's main event: individual matches.
episodes.title: The Dark Nobleman

episodes.synopsis: The Brits display their monstrous talent: Percival's impressive backswing and Tristan's incredible power and precision fire up Gawain and Lancelot.
episodes.title: Monsters

episodes.synopsis: As the competition grows more heated and the young golfers battle it out on the fairways, Gawain's Gift attracts a mysterious man's attention.
episodes.title: An Approaching Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Wanglian's mastery over turbulent winds stuns everyone. Meanwhile, Lancelot's confidence starts to shatter as he loses control of his strokes.
episodes.title: Heart of Glass

episodes.synopsis: Gawain enters an injury-induced trance after being hit by Percival's ball, and a profound power emerges from him. Lancelot continues to falter.
episodes.title: Awaken!

episodes.synopsis: Thanks to Gawain's words, Lancelot gets back his confidence — and his Gift. Gawain's uncanny performance continues and catches Tristan's attention.
episodes.title: A Contest of Gift

episodes.synopsis: Finding himself shaken by Lancelot and Gawain's skills, Tristan reevaluates his motivations. Gawain refuses to back down despite his worsening injury.
episodes.title: To the Top

episodes.synopsis: The Camelot Cup draws to a close, and the young golfers reflect on their results. At the hospital, Gawain gets an intriguing invite from Arthur.
episodes.title: See You Again!
